cases.sentence: Тогда хозяин послал к ним ___; но они разбили ему голову и издевались над ним.
cases.explain: «другого слугу» — the accusative marks the direct object of the verb.
cases.translation: Again, he sent another servant to them; and they threw stones at him, wounded him in the head, and sent him away shamefully treated.

cases.sentence: В конце концов у хозяина остался только его единственный ___.
cases.explain: «любимый сын» — the subject of the sentence stands in the nominative.
cases.translation: Therefore still having one, his beloved son, he sent him last to them, saying, ‘They will respect my son.’

cases.sentence: Моисей написал, что если ___ умрет, не оставив детей, то его брат должен жениться на вдове и восстановить сына своему брату .
cases.explain: «женатый мужчина» — the subject of the sentence stands in the nominative.
cases.translation: “Teacher, Moses wrote to us, ‘If a man’s brother dies, and leaves a wife behind him, and leaves no children, that his brother should take his wife, and raise up offspring for his brother.’

cases.sentence: Они сидят на самых почетных местах в синагогах и на ___.
cases.explain: «званых обедах» — after the preposition «на», for location or topic.
cases.translation: and the best seats in the synagogues, and the best places at feasts:

cases.explain: «суровое наказание» — the subject of the sentence stands in the nominative.
cases.translation: those who devour widows’ houses, and for a pretense make long prayers. These will receive greater condemnation.”

cases.explain: «Многие богачи» — the subject of the sentence stands in the nominative.
cases.translation: Jesus sat down opposite the treasury, and saw how the multitude cast money into the treasury. Many who were rich cast in much.

cases.sentence: Но вот подошла ___ и бросила всего две мелкие монеты .
cases.explain: «бедная вдова» — the subject of the sentence stands in the nominative.
cases.translation: A poor widow came, and she cast in two small brass coins, which equal a quadrans coin.
